Style UI

A directory of UI component libraries, design.md generators, and background generators.

Style UI lists 57 tools across three categories. Every entry links to the original product, shows a screenshot, and marks its pricing model: Free, Semi-free, or Paid. Nothing is hosted here, and browsing needs no account. > Official source: [github.com/miqdadbadjuber/style-ui](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/style-ui). Official site: [style.ai.id](https://style.ai.id). ## Catalog | Category | Entries | Page | | --- | ---: | --- | | UI components and libraries | 47 | [style.ai.id/ui-components](https://style.ai.id/ui-components) | | Background and shader generators | 6 | [style.ai.id/background-generator](https://style.ai.id/background-generator) | | Design.md generators | 4 | [style.ai.id/design-md](https://style.ai.id/design-md) | Each card carries one of three labels: | Label | Meaning | | --- | --- | | Free | The full product is available at no cost. | | Semi‑free | Free with conditions, such as an account, a usage limit, or only part of the product. | | Paid | Payment is required. Some products offer a trial. | Each category page has search, a pricing filter, and cards with a live preview. The homepage carries a Top Today rail and the same cards in three rows. The site runs on plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no build step. ## Contributing - Submit a tool with the [submission form](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/style-ui/issues/new?template=submit-tool.yml). - Report a broken link or a layout bug with the [bug report form](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/style-ui/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml). - Ask questions or share tools in the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/VWKggJfHFR). - Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request. Local setup and the validation command are covered there. - Follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) in every discussion. - Report security issues privately, as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Planned work lives in [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md). ## Attribution Style UI is an independent directory. Product names, logos, and screenshots belong to their respective owners and appear here for identification only. No affiliation or endorsement is implied. If you own a listed product and want the entry corrected or removed, open an issue. ## Privacy No accounts, no cookies, no analytics. [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md) lists the two local storage keys and the third-party requests. ## License MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Style UI is a static site. The current deployment at https://style.ai.id is supported. There are no versioned releases yet.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting:

https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/style-ui/security/advisories/new

Do not open a public issue for a security report.

Please include:

- A description of the issue and the affected page.
- Steps to reproduce it.
- The impact you expect.
- A suggested fix, if you have one.
- A safe way to contact you.

## Scope

Reports about the following are in scope:

- Cross-site scripting or script injection through site code.
- Content Security Policy or security header gaps.
- Supply chain issues in third-party scripts or fonts.
- Exposed secrets or credentials in the repository.
- Links that redirect to an unexpected destination.

## Out of scope

The following are out of scope:

- Vulnerabilities in third-party products listed in the directory.
- Issues that require physical access to the visitor's device.
- Reports that only reproduce on unsupported browsers.
- Social engineering or phishing against the maintainer.

## Response

I aim to acknowledge a report within 7 days and to fix confirmed issues as soon as practical. I will credit the reporter in the fix unless you ask to remain anonymous.

from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
IMAGES = ROOT / "assets" / "images"
SCREENSHOT = Path(r"C:\Users\Miqdad\Pictures\Screenshots\Screenshot 2026-11-01 112427.png")
LOGO = IMAGES / "logo.png"


def cover_crop(image: Image.Image, width: int, height: int) -> Image.Image:
    source_ratio = image.width / image.height
    target_ratio = width / height
    if source_ratio > target_ratio:
        new_width = int(image.height * target_ratio)
        left = (image.width - new_width) // 2
        image = image.crop((left, 0, left + new_width, image.height))
    else:
        new_height = int(image.width / target_ratio)
        top = (image.height - new_height) // 2
        image = image.crop((0, top, image.width, top + new_height))
    return image.resize((width, height), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)


def rounded_icon(source: Image.Image, size: int, radius_ratio: float = 0.22, padding_ratio: float = 0.08) -> Image.Image:
    canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (size, size), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    padding = int(size * padding_ratio)
    inner = size - (padding * 2)
    mark = source.resize((inner, inner), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    mask = Image.new("L", (inner, inner), 0)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        (0, 0, inner - 1, inner - 1),
        radius=int(inner * radius_ratio),
        fill=255,
    )
    canvas.paste(mark, (padding, padding), mask)
    return canvas


def rounded_image(source: Image.Image, radius: int) -> Image.Image:
    mask = Image.new("L", source.size, 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle(
        (0, 0, source.width - 1, source.height - 1),
        radius=radius,
        fill=255,
    )
    output = source.convert("RGBA")
    output.putalpha(mask)
    return output


def main() -> None:
    IMAGES.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    screenshot = Image.open(SCREENSHOT).convert("RGB")
    cover_crop(screenshot, 1200, 630).save(IMAGES / "og-image.jpg", quality=90, optimize=True)

    readme_width = 1600
    readme_height = round(readme_width * screenshot.height / screenshot.width)
    readme = screenshot.resize((readme_width, readme_height), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    rounded_image(readme, 30).save(IMAGES / "readme-hero.webp", quality=88, method=6)

    logo = Image.open(LOGO).convert("RGB")
    luminance = logo.convert("L")
    bright = luminance.point(lambda value: 255 if value > 200 else 0)
    bbox = bright.getbbox()
    if bbox is None:
        raise SystemExit("Could not find the white mark in logo.png")

    left, top, right, bottom = bbox
    side = max(right - left, bottom - top)
    pad = int(side * 0.18)
    center_x = (left + right) // 2
    center_y = (top + bottom) // 2
    half = (side // 2) + pad
    crop = (
        max(0, center_x - half),
        max(0, center_y - half),
        min(logo.width, center_x + half),
        min(logo.height, center_y + half),
    )
    mark = logo.crop(crop)

    for size in (16, 32):
        icon = rounded_icon(mark, size)
        icon.save(IMAGES / f"favicon-{size}x{size}.png", optimize=True)

    rounded_icon(mark, 180).save(IMAGES / "apple-touch-icon.png", optimize=True)
    rounded_icon(mark, 192).save(IMAGES / "icon-192.png", optimize=True)
    rounded_icon(mark, 512).save(IMAGES / "icon-512.png", optimize=True)

    ico_sizes = [(16, 16), (32, 32), (48, 48)]
    rounded_icon(mark, 48).save(IMAGES / "favicon.ico", sizes=ico_sizes)

    print("Generated brand assets in", IMAGES)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

name: Feature request
description: Propose a feature or a change to the site.
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: problem
    attributes:
      label: Problem
      description: What problem does this solve for a visitor or a contributor?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: proposal
    attributes:
      label: Proposal
      description: Describe the change and how it would work.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: alternatives
    attributes:
      label: Alternatives considered
      description: Other approaches you considered, if any.
  - type: checkboxes
    id: checks
    attributes:
      label: Checks
      options:
        - label: I checked the roadmap and this feature is not already planned.
          required: true

name: Bug report
description: Report a problem with the site.
title: "[Bug] "
labels: ["bug"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Thanks for the report. Include enough detail to reproduce the problem.
  - type: dropdown
    id: page
    attributes:
      label: Page
      options:
        - Homepage
        - UI Components
        - Background Generator
        - Design.md
        - Another page
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: browser
    attributes:
      label: Browser and device
      placeholder: Firefox 140 on Windows 11
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: steps
    attributes:
      label: Steps to reproduce
      placeholder: |
        1. Open the page.
        2. Click the filter.
        3. ...
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: expected
    attributes:
      label: Expected behavior
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: actual
    attributes:
      label: Actual behavior
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: evidence
    attributes:
      label: Screenshots or console output
      description: Drag in a screenshot or paste the browser console output.
  - type: checkboxes
    id: checks
    attributes:
      label: Checks
      options:
        - label: I searched the existing issues and this problem is not reported.
          required: true

name: Submit a tool
description: Suggest a tool for the directory.
title: "[Tool] "
labels: ["submission"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Thanks for the suggestion. Search the directory first to avoid duplicates.
  - type: input
    id: name
    attributes:
      label: Tool name
      placeholder: Aceternity UI
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: url
    attributes:
      label: Website URL
      placeholder: https://example.com
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: category
    attributes:
      label: Category
      options:
        - UI components and libraries
        - Background and shader generators
        - Design.md generators
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: pricing
    attributes:
      label: Pricing
      options:
        - Free
        - Semi-free
        - Paid
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: description
    attributes:
      label: Short description
      description: One or two sentences. Explain what the tool does.
      placeholder: A component library for React with animated primitives.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: logo
    attributes:
      label: Logo URL
      description: A square logo, at least 128 x 128 pixels.
  - type: input
    id: preview
    attributes:
      label: Preview image URL
      description: A screenshot of the tool, at least 1200 pixels wide.
  - type: checkboxes
    id: checks
    attributes:
      label: Checks
      options:
        - label: I searched the directory and this tool is not listed.
          required: true
        - label: I am the owner, or I have permission to submit this tool.
          required: true
